info.name: FutureSuShi - BVA Points
info.description: 5 BVA cases for SRS current_balance [0, 10,000,000]. Each case resets User.points via the existing admin User API, creates an eligible Order, marks it READY, pays it CASH, then calls /api/points/add-points. Uses target_user_id=2 from the existing environment. Point rate oracle: floor(finalPrice/100*5).

item.name: BVA-POINT-001 - Baseline 5,000,000

exec: pm.test('Target user exists',()=>pm.expect(u,'User id '+targetId+' not found').to.exist);

request.description: Reads existing target_user_id from environment, extracts its phone for the point API, and stores the user record for the balance reset.
The project admin UI exposes PUT /api/orders/:id/status; payment requires READY or COMPLETED.
Project payOrder updates paymentStatus=PAID and status=COMPLETED.

exec: if(5000000 < 9999999) pm.test('New balance equals start + earned points',()=>pm.expect(total).to.eql(5000000+earned));
if(5000000 >= 9999999) pm.test('Balance does not exceed SRS maximum',()=>pm.expect(total).to.be.at.most(10000000));

request.description: SRS BVA current_balance=5000000. Order must be PAID+COMPLETED+isPointsAdded=false. point_rate=5 per 100 VND; earnedPoints=floor(finalPrice/100*5).

item.description: current_balance=5000000. Setup resets User.points to 5000000, then creates/pays an eligible order and executes add-points.
